title: Harvest Yuuka
description:
A Farming Life in Gensokyo
Harvest Yuuka (Japanese title: 幻想ガーデン物語 / Gensou Garden Monogatari) is a farming life simulation set in the world of Touhou Project. Originally released for Nintendo Switch in 2022, the game is now coming to Steam!

Play as Kazami Yuuka, the flower youkai who lives in the Garden of the Sun. Grow seasonal crops, care for animals, go fishing, cook meals, improve your tools and home, and get to know the residents of Gensokyo at your own pace.Features• Farming — Plant, water, and harvest crops that grow in each season.

• Animal Care — Raise cows, sheep, and chickens, and collect milk, wool, and eggs.

• Fishing — Cast your line at fishing spots around Gensokyo and catch a variety of fish.

• Cooking — Learn recipes and turn crops, fish, and animal products into meals.

• Shops & Upgrades — Upgrade tools at the Kirisame Magic Shop, ask the carpenter to renovate your home, and buy useful information from Aya.

• Character Events — Talk with the residents of Gensokyo and get to know them through a variety of events.

• Four Seasons — Different crops grow in each season as the scenery changes throughout the year.
Featured Characters• Kazami Yuuka — The flower youkai who lives in the Garden of the Sun, and the protagonist of this game.

• Medicine Melancholy — A poison doll born from a lily-of-the-valley garden.

• Cirno — The cheerful ice fairy known as "⑨".

• Wriggle Nightbug — A firefly youkai who can command insects.

• Yakumo Ran — A wise nine-tailed shikigami who lives in Mayohiga.

• Shameimaru Aya — A crow tengu newspaper reporter who sells useful information.

• Luna Child — One of the Three Fairies of Light, and the fairy of moonlight.

• ...and many other familiar and expressive characters from Touhou Project.
Supported Languages• Japanese (interface, subtitles)

• English (interface, subtitles)
Steam Port from Nintendo SwitchThis is the Steam port of Harvest Yuuka, originally released for Nintendo Switch in 2022 and published by Mediascape Co., Ltd.NoticeThis game is a fan-made work based on Touhou Project.
description_short: Harvest Yuuka is a farming life simulation set in Gensokyo, first released for Nintendo Switch in 2022. Play as Kazami Yuuka as you grow seasonal crops, raise cows, sheep, and chickens, and enjoy fishing, cooking, and time with the residents of Gensokyo.
